content.value: Assignment evaluates the right side before replacing the variable. Operators +=, -=, *=, /= and %= combine an operation with assignment. Increment and decrement change an integer by one. Trace statements in order; integer division still truncates toward zero.
The values of points are 7, 12, 6, then 5. In AP-style code, use ++ and -- as separate statements so the timing of the update is clear.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
